title: Unthemed Bootstrap kit shipped verbatim: default primary blue and gray borders
evidence: Every value is the Bootstrap 5 default: .navbar and .btn-primary background #0d6efd (lines 3, 8-9), hover #0b5ed7 / border #0a58ca (14-15), table borders #dee2e6 (19, 23), focus ring #0b5ed7 (29). No token layer, so nobody made a colour decision. The primary also measures oklch(0.578 0.228 260.0), inside the AI-purple window (aliases: C3, C15 hex-not-OKLCH). Fix: define a brand token outside hue 255-325, e.g. --brand: oklch(0.6 0.15 45) copper with --brand-hover: oklch(from var(--brand) calc(l - 0.05) c h), tune the border token against the surface (--rule: oklch(0.9 0.006 60)), and route .navbar/.btn-primary/focus through them. Keep the 2px focus-visible ring.

title: Cream ground, Instrument Serif display and sage accent: the tasteful-default combination
evidence: All three legs: background #faf8f5 (line 8, a listed cream hex, oklch(0.98 0.005 78)), font-family 'Instrument Serif' on body and the h1 (10, 14), sage #15573a on the accent span and the button (15, 17), plus the empty screenshot card on the right (.shot, line 18, 28). Fix: anchor colour and type to the product's real brand or a stated reference rather than swapping to another tasteful palette; if warm-editorial is the brief, keep it and mark the lines anti-slop-allow: <brief quote>. Replace the placeholder .shot with the real product (a screenshot of a grove page) so the hero keeps its focal visual.

title: Emoji used as interface chrome: status dots, checklist bullets and a rocket in the deploy button
evidence: Seven emoji outside prose: status column 🟢 🟡 🔴 (lines 37-39), checklist bullets ✅ ✅ ⚠️ (43-45), rocket 🚀 inside the Deploy button (47). Fix: a 0.5rem status glyph drawn in CSS or one icon family (check, warning, x) coloured from tokens -- e.g. --ok: oklch(0.6 0.13 145), --warn: oklch(0.72 0.14 75), --bad: oklch(0.58 0.17 25) -- keeping the text labels so state is never colour-only; drop the rocket and let the button label carry the action ('Deploy api again'). The table and the checks stay; only the emoji glyphs change.

title: Hero switches to Lobster, a face the DESIGN.md typography never declares
evidence: .hero { font-family: "Lobster", cursive; } (line 13) while design-system/DESIGN.md declares Söhne as the one face (typography.body.fontFamily, and 'Söhne is the one face') and body uses Söhne (line 9). Confirmed drift, not a documented exception. Fix: set the hero in the declared face and get display character from weight, size and tracking: .hero { font-family: "Söhne", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 3.2vw, 3rem); }, or add a display face to DESIGN.md first if the brand wants one.

title: Fixed 1200px shell, asserted 3x360px lane grid and no viewport meta
evidence: No <meta name="viewport"> in the head (lines 3-5), so phones render a 980px canvas; .shell { width: 1200px } (15), .lede { width: 640px } (17), .lanes { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 360px) } (18). The layout breaks at every width under 1200px. Fix: add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> (no user-scalable=no); .shell { width: min(100% - 2rem, 75rem); padding: clamp(1.5rem, 1rem + 3vw, 4rem) clamp(1rem, 0.5rem + 2vw, 2.5rem); }; .lede { max-width: 58ch; }; .lanes { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 18rem), 1fr)); gap: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); }; h1 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 3vw, 3rem); } keeping the -0.025em tracking.

title: Middle-dot meta strings repeated on all three lane rows
evidence: '1,382 mi · $2.41/mi · 62 loads posted' and its two siblings (lines 32, 36, 40): six spaced middle dots, over the three-instance threshold. Fix: make the fields structured so they align and scan, e.g. a <dl class="lane-facts"> with Distance / Rate / Loads posted, or three inline <span>s separated by a 1px vertical-rule token (border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-inline-start: 0.75rem). Keep the --signal colour and tabular-nums on the rate.

title: Flat-terminal system: near-black ground, 8% hairline as the only edge, accent at chroma 0.02
evidence: --ground oklch(0.12 0.003 270) vs --panel oklch(0.13 0.003 270) is a 1.009:1 tint step (needs 1.15:1); the only panel and row boundary is --hair oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08), about 1.17:1 against panel and ground (needs 1.3:1); --accent oklch(0.6 0.02 270) is under the 0.10 chroma floor and appears only as nav text, so colour is reserved for status (--ok, --bad); no elevation; system-ui at weight 400 everywhere (lines 8-19, 27, 31). The substance-floor surface-ladder and edge checks fail together with the accent chroma floor on one data surface. Fix (add, don't strip): ground derived from the brand hue, e.g. oklch(0.16 0.012 250); panel oklch(0.21 0.014 250) plus a rim box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08), 0 8px 20px oklch(0.05 0.01 250 / 0.5); edges at oklch(0.32 0.012 250); an accent at oklch(0.72 0.13 230) used as the current-nav underline, the KPI value colour and a filled primary action; heading weights 600/650 with -0.015em tracking.

title: Both buttons draw the ring on :focus, so mouse clicks get the keyboard ring
evidence: Lines 31 and 34: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-600 focus:ring-offset-2, the only focus treatment the surface defines, with no focus-visible: variant. The indicator survives (not U3), but mouse and keyboard focus look the same. Fix: move the ring to focus-visible -- focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 -- and give the select the same focus-visible ring so every control reads alike for keyboard users.

title: Frosted-glass sticky nav with the backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 class run
evidence: <nav class="backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 border-b sticky top-0"> (line 12): the verbatim fingerprint (aliases: L6, Strongest-10 #2, section 11 frosted nav). Fix: a solid nav on a raised surface with a brand tint, e.g. background: oklch(0.97 0.01 60); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.88 0.01 60), a static header unless content scrolls under it, or a sidebar; keep the CTA.

title: Neon purple glow box-shadow on the nav call-to-action
evidence: .cta { box-shadow: 0 0 40px 6px rgba(168,85,247,.6); } (line 8): purple-500 (oklch 0.627 0.233 303.9) as a 40px saturated halo on a light nav with no dark-mode reason (aliases: C3 purple family). Fix: a rim plus a tuned drop instead of the halo -- box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.25), 0 2px 6px oklch(0.2 0.02 45 / 0.18) -- on a brand fill outside hue 255-325, e.g. background: oklch(0.58 0.16 40).

title: Links and buttons strip the outline on :focus with no :focus-visible replacement
evidence: a:focus, button:focus { outline: none; } (line 9) and no :focus-visible rule anywhere, so the 'Open the firing schedule' button and any link have no keyboard focus indicator (WCAG 2.4.7). Fix: replace the rule with a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.14 40); outline-offset: 2px; } and drop the blanket outline: none.

title: Hero h1 painted with purple-fuchsia-blue gradient text via bg-clip-text
evidence: h1 class="text-5xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 via-fuchsia-500 to-blue-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent" (line 7) on 'Welcome to the platform' (aliases: V5, C3 purple family, C5 purple-to-pink gradient). Fix: solid ink on the headline with hierarchy from size and weight -- color: oklch(0.22 0.02 60); font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.4rem + 3.5vw, 3.75rem); letter-spacing: -0.025em -- and give the hero a real focal visual (the invoice dashboard screenshot) instead of the gradient.

title: Neutral mid-gray text set on saturated blue promo blocks
evidence: bg-blue-800 text-gray-300 (line 16) and .promo { background: #1e40af; color: #d1d5db; } (line 10, used on line 17): a chroma-0.009 gray on oklch(0.424 0.181 265.6), untuned to the surface (aliases: C3 for the Tailwind blue fill). Fix: tint the secondary text from the surface hue, e.g. color: oklch(from var(--promo) 0.9 0.04 h), and move the fill outside the 255-325 window, e.g. --promo: oklch(0.42 0.11 235) deep-prussian; keep contrast at or above 4.5:1.

title: Hero h1 carries the verbatim text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight run
evidence: <h1 class="text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight"> (line 20), the unmodified copy-paste string (aliases: Strongest-10 #9, T14 stepped type scale). Fix: keep it responsive but fluid -- style="font-size: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 5vw, 4.5rem); letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-weight: 650" or a --step-3 custom property -- never a single fixed size.

title: Camera product page has 12 icon cards in 4 sections and zero product photographs
evidence: A visual product (the Verge M2 rangefinder) whose header and four sections (lines 29-53) contain 0 img/picture/figure/video against a floor of 1 per 2 sections (needs 2+); every section is an icon-card grid of generic stroke SVGs (12 cards). Fix: show the camera -- a hero product shot in the header (), and per section a detail photograph or figure (the shutter curtain, the M mount, the calibration screws); keep the spec cards beside them.

title: Trash icon-only remove button has no accessible name
evidence: <button class="remove" type="button"><svg ...></svg></button> (line 36): no aria-label, no visually hidden text, no <title>; screen readers announce 'button' (WCAG 4.1.2). Fix: <button class="remove" type="button" aria-label="Delete draft: Re: bench slot for the tenor sax"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" ...></svg></button>; the 2.75rem target and focus-visible ring stay.

title: Cream #faf8f5 ground plus Instrument Serif display completes the tasteful-default pair
evidence: body { background: #faf8f5; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; } (line 7): two legs of cream-serif-sage on one rule. Fix: anchor colour and type to the product's real brand; if warm-editorial is a stated decision keep it with anti-slop-allow: <reason>; otherwise an off-white ground (oklch(0.985 0.004 250)) and a sans display with tuned weight and tracking.

title: Hero headline is vague benefit copy: Transform your workflow. Effortlessly.
evidence:
Transform your workflow. Effortlessly.

(line 12), the page's only value proposition and a listed generic formula (aliases: W5 SaaS-speak). Fix: lead with the specific job the subtitle already names, e.g.

Plan the whole team's week on one board

, or a concrete outcome with a number.

title: Stock unDraw team-collaboration illustration is the page's only image
evidence: (line 14): the flat-vector stock style, brandless. Fix: replace with a real screenshot of the weekly planning board, , so the page keeps a focal visual.

title: App shell fixed at width 1180px, height 100vh and repeat(4, 260px) columns
evidence: .app-shell { width: 1180px; height: 100vh; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 260px); } (lines 2-8) cannot resize, and 100vh hides the bottom of the shell behind mobile browser chrome (aliases: P3). Fix: width: min(100%, 74rem); min-height: 100dvh; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr)); gap from a spacing token, as tokens-clean.css already does.

title: Pulsing 8px dot beside the Live label plus an animate-ping dot on the queue line
evidence:
.live-dot runs pulse 1.6s infinite (scale and opacity, lines 11-18) next to 'Live' (line 27); a rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-ping dot sits beside 'Four people are waiting' (line 28). Fix: content-borne liveness instead of the ornament -- a live count and timestamp (

4 waiting, updated 12 s ago

) in an aria-live="polite" region, with a static status dot if a marker is wanted.

title: Decorative fuchsia blur blob class run behind the hero
evidence: <div class="absolute -z-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-fuchsia-300 blur-3xl opacity-20"> (line 9), the section-11 blur-blob signature. Fix: replace with a real focal visual -- a product screenshot of the sync view -- or a solid brand block or grain under 0.05 opacity.

title: Welcome back! greeting used as the hero subtext
evidence:
Welcome back! Pick up where the last sync left off.

(line 14). Fix: show what only this user would see -- e.g. 'Last sync 3 h ago: 214 records merged, 2 conflicts waiting' -- or, on a marketing page, a specific benefit line.

title: Primary CTA filled with an indigo-500 to violet-600 gradient
evidence: Start the tour (line 15): both stops in the AI-purple family (hue 277 and 293). Fix: one committed brand fill outside 255-325 and at least 30 degrees from indigo, e.g. background: oklch(0.58 0.16 40) burnt-orange with hover oklch(from var(--brand) calc(l - 0.05) c h); no gradient.

title: Stats card shows the shadcn demo value $45,231.89 +20.1% from last month
evidence: 'Total revenue' / '$45,231.89' / '+20.1% from last month' (lines 22-24), verbatim from the shadcn dashboard example. Fix: a real figure from the product with real context, e.g. '1,284 records synced today' with 'vs 1,102 last Tuesday' and a small sparkline.

title: Logo track scrolls forever at 30s linear infinite with no pause control
evidence: .track { animation: scroll 30s linear infinite; } translating -50% (lines 12-16), duplicated logos (27-29), no pause/stop control or hover pause; the reduced-motion gate does not cover readers who never set it (WCAG 2.2.2; aliases: L8 logo marquee). Fix: a static logo strip -- .track { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2rem 3rem; } with logos at opacity 0.6 and full colour on hover -- and drop the duplicate set; or keep motion only with a visible Pause button and animation-play-state: paused on :hover and :focus-within.

title: Refresh button's onclick is only a TODO comment and does nothing
evidence: <button onclick="/* TODO: wire refresh */">Refresh</button> (line 18): a visible control with no behaviour. Fix: wire it to the invoice fetch with a busy state -- disabled and labelled 'Refreshing invoices...' while in flight, an aria-live status on completion -- or remove the button until refresh exists.

title: Invoice table renders only populated, all-paid rows: no empty, loading, error or overdue state
evidence: <tbody> (lines 24-28) holds three hard-coded 'Paid' rows; there is no empty branch, no loading state, no fetch-error state and no Unpaid/Overdue status style. Fix: design the empty state first (a row reading 'No invoices yet -- create one from a client page' with the action), a loading row matching the table geometry, an error row with a Retry action, and .status.overdue / .status.due styles paired with text so state is not colour-only.

title: JetBrains Mono applied to talent levels, point totals, ranks and table numbers
evidence: --font-mono:"JetBrains Mono" (line 2) is set on talent-level-value, talent-level-preset (a 44px control), talent-tree-points, talent-points-spent, talent-node-rank and talent-table td.num (lines 7-18): human-readable stats and a button label, not code. Each already carries font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Fix: drop font-family: var(--font-mono) from those six rules so they inherit --font-sans, keeping tabular-nums for alignment and --font-weight-emphasis for hierarchy. The talent-field textarea and readonly input (lines 19-21) hold the raw build string and keep mono.

title: Order toast, account menu and arrow cue all use bounce motion
evidence: .toast { animation: bounce-in 600ms } whose keyframes (0, -24px, 0, -10px, 0) reverse direction three times (lines 15, 18-24); .menu transitions on cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55), anticipating (y1 -0.55) and overshooting (y2 1.55) (16); the arrow carries animate-bounce (35). Three instances of one bouncy preset on a confirmation. Fix: match motion to gravity -- toast: transform 220ms with a single settle, e.g. linear(0, 0.42 12%, 0.99 31%, 1.04 42%, 1); menu: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); drop the bouncing arrow. Keep the no-preference gate.

title: Three orphan paragraphs dropped into main between the KPI tiles and the invoice table
evidence:
Lines 34-36: three

whose parent is

, with no heading over them and a card grid (ul.tiles) and a table as siblings; 27, 63 and 24 words (114 total; the 63-word one is over the 60-word single-orphan limit). Fix: give each a home without adding to the prose run below -- the refresh note becomes the tiles' caption ('Refreshed hourly from the ledger service'), and the collections and credits rules go behind a
Why a customer can leave this table directly under the table, or into the Payment terms
the L14 fix creates; never deleted.

title: How balances, Payment terms and Who to contact form a run of three text-only sections
evidence: Sections at lines 45, 49 and 53 each hold an h2 and two paragraphs with no img, table, list, dl, figure or control: a text-only run of 3. Fix: a non-text device every second section -- payment terms as a <dl> (Standard: net 30; Enterprise: per contract; Late fees: daily, assessed at close) and contacts as a <ul> of owner, inbox and scope -- rather than more prose.

title: Hairline grid, dot field and diagonal stripes as decorative backgrounds
evidence: body::before two 1px linear-gradients at right angles on a 24px tile (lines 13-14); .hero radial-gradient 1px dot on a 16px tile (18); .promo repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, ... 0 8px, transparent 8px 16px) stripes (19). Three decorative patterns, no information. Fix: background tone shifts between sections instead -- .hero { background: oklch(0.97 0.01 80); } .promo { background: oklch(0.95 0.025 80); } -- or a photograph of the launch.

title: Gradient text clipped onto the single hero word reconciled
evidence: .accent { background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.62 0.15 25), oklch(0.72 0.16 60)); background-clip: text; color: transparent; } (lines 17-22) on reconciled in the h1 (28), with no anti-slop-allow line (aliases: T15 single accented word). Fix: carry emphasis with the whole headline -- size, weight 500 to 600, the serif itself -- and set the word in the ink; if the gradient is the 2024 identity's wordmark treatment, mark the rule anti-slop-allow: as allowed-choice.html does.

title: 281 words of About prose sit above the drop-sources table, the page's primary content
evidence: Primary element: the drop-sources <table> (line 47). Above it: the 27-word lede (34) and four About paragraphs of 75, 63, 60 and 56 words (40-43) = 281 words against the 40-word lede budget for a reference page. Fix: keep the identity block and lede on top, move the Drop sources section directly under the header, and move the About text below it as a headed section or a <details><summary>How these figures are collected</summary>, keeping every fact.

title: Saturated cyan radial-gradient halo behind the dark hero
evidence: .hero { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.8), transparent 70%); } (line 10): an 80%-opaque cyan-400 first stop fading to transparent on a #0b0b10 page, the CSS form of the blur blob. Fix: atmosphere under 0.05 or a real subject -- e.g. radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, oklch(0.6 0.08 210 / 0.05), transparent 70%) plus a photograph of the support desk or the rota itself as the focal element.

title: Reading mechanics set against the reader: -0.1em h1, 1.15 body leading, 0.12em body tracking, 22ch justify
evidence: .hero h1 letter-spacing -0.1em at 32px, past the -0.07em floor (line 10; aliases: T8); .article p line-height 1.15 under 1.3 (11); .note p letter-spacing 0.12em on mixed-case running text (12); .sidebar-note width 22ch with text-align: justify and no hyphens (13). Fix: h1 letter-spacing -0.02em; .article p line-height 1.5; .note p letter-spacing 0 (or -0.005em); .sidebar-note text-align: start, or keep justify with hyphens: auto on the lang="en" document.

title: Plan usage card is the shadcn Card class run rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6
evidence: <div class="rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6"> (line 6): the library's Card primitive (pre-v4 rounded-lg generation) untouched. Fix: keep the frame and tune it -- a radius the system states (e.g. --radius-panel: 6px), a border colour that measures 1.3:1 against the surface, a role-based elevation instead of shadow-sm, padding from the spacing scale (see design/06-shadcn-customization).

title: Both cards repeat the rounded shadow-sm border trio, including rounded-xl shadow-sm border
evidence: Line 10: shadow-sm hover:shadow-md border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4; line 6 carries the same border + shadow-sm + radius treatment, so every card on a two-card surface has the identical trio (aliases: L5 cards everywhere). Fix: commit the trio by role rather than deleting it -- the usage panel keeps one framed edge with a stated radius and a measured border, the explanatory block becomes an unframed section separated by a tone shift (background: oklch(0.97 0.006 250)).

title: Root tokens are the shadcn v4 init values verbatim: radius 0.625rem, primary oklch(0.205 0 0)
evidence: --radius: 0.625rem; --background: oklch(1 0 0); --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0); --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0); --border/--input oklch(0.922 0 0); --ring oklch(0.708 0 0) (lines 8-20): a diff against the current shadcn neutral scaffold is empty (aliases: C2 pure-white ground). Fix: --primary: oklch(0.58 0.16 40) (first hue decision; derive hover/soft with oklch(from var(--primary) ...)), --background: oklch(0.985 0.004 90), --foreground: oklch(0.22 0.015 60), --border/--input tuned to 1.3:1 against the card, a radius identity such as --radius: 4px.

title: Plan usage block is the untouched shadcn Card run rounded-xl border bg-card shadow-sm p-6
evidence: <div class="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6"> (line 35): the verbatim library class run on top of the init tokens. Fix: keep one framed panel for the usage figure but recompose it -- a stated radius, a border that measures against the ground, a usage meter (42 of 100 as a bar) as the panel's focal element.

title: Coloured left stripes on five note blocks in five syntaxes
evidence: .tip border-left 4px on a 12px-radius card (line 11); .quote border-inline-start 3px on a square blockquote (12); .feature::before 4px absolute bar (14); .panel box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 (15); rounded-xl border-l-4 border-teal-600 (25). None encodes selection, severity or state (aliases: V2). Fix: a heading device or icon on the notes that mean something -- e.g. a small 'Frost' label with a warning icon on the forecast, a quote set in italic with a hanging mark -- and a background tone shift (oklch(0.97 0.01 180)) for grouping; no side bars.

title: Refund timing heading jumps from h2 to h4 and is restyled to 1.25rem
evidence:
Sending an item back

(16) followed by

Refund timing

(18), with h4 { font-size: 1.25rem } (10) picking the level for size. Fix:

Refund timing

and style the level you need, e.g. h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; }.

title: Cross-page view transition runs 650ms, past the 400ms ceiling
evidence: ::view-transition-old(root), ::view-transition-new(root) { animation-duration: 650ms; } (line 17) on every route change via @view-transition { navigation: auto; } (15). Fix: animation-duration: 280ms with ease-out (200-400ms for page changes), keeping the reduced-motion gate.

title: Save button hardcodes a near-brand green, 11px 17px padding and 5px radius beside defined tokens
evidence: .save background oklch(0.543 0.104 159) instead of var(--brand) oklch(0.49 0.085 158) (line 24), hover oklch(0.5 0.11 160) (30), padding 11px 17px beside --space-300: 12px (26), border-radius 5px beside --radius: 6px (27); .hint margin-top 9px and font-size 13px (31); .panel border a raw oklch (19). Fix: background: var(--brand); hover: oklch(from var(--brand) calc(l - 0.04) c h); padding: var(--space-300) calc(var(--space-300) + var(--space-100)); border-radius: var(--radius); .hint margin-top: var(--space-200); add a --rule token for the panel border.

title: Renewal paragraph at 11px, price note at 10px and footer links at 10px
evidence: .article p font-size 11px on a 43-word running paragraph (line 10, under the 12px running floor); .price-note 0.625rem = 10px inline in running text (11); .footer-nav a 10px links (12, under the 11px functional floor). Fix: .article p { font-size: 1rem; } (or clamp(1rem, 0.96rem + 0.2vw, 1.0625rem)); .price-note { font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.45 0.01 250); } for hierarchy by colour; .footer-nav a { font-size: 0.8125rem; } with the hit area padded to 24px.

title: Inputs, select, textarea, three chips and the submit button all share border-radius 8px
evidence: border-radius: 8px on input/select/textarea (line 21), .chip (25) and button.submit (27): seven controls on the shadcn pre-v4 default radius (aliases: S2). Fix: commit a radius identity by role -- --radius-control: 3px for fields and the submit, --radius-chip: 999px only on the filter chips -- so the chips read as toggles and the fields as fields.

title: Input, select, textarea, tag and submit all use rounded-full pills
evidence: rounded-full on the input (line 28), select (33), a three-row textarea (41), the 'runs at 04:00' tag (45) and the submit (48): one radius on every control, and a pill clips the multi-line textarea's corners (aliases: S2). Fix: a radius language by role -- rounded-[3px] on input, select, textarea and the submit, rounded-full kept only on the status tag.

title: Route app sized with 100vh and a fixed bottom action bar with no safe-area inset
evidence: .app { height: 100vh } (line 16) and .bar { position: fixed; bottom: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem } (21-22) with no env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and no viewport-fit=cover: on mobile the last stop and the 'Mark delivered' button sit under browser chrome or the home indicator (aliases: L13). Fix: .app { height: 100dvh; } .bar { padding-bottom: max(0.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); } and viewport content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"; give .scroll padding-bottom equal to the bar height so the last row clears it.

title: Firing card switches to two columns on a 60rem viewport query while it sits in both the rail and main
evidence: @media (min-width: 60rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; } } (lines 30-33) while .firing renders inside the 14-18rem .rail (40) and the wide .main (46): at 60rem+ the rail copy gets a 9rem label column inside a ~16rem rail. Fix: .rail, .main { container-type: inline-size; } and @container (min-width: 28rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; column-gap: 1.5rem; } }.

title: Viewport meta sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no
evidence: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no"> (line 5) blocks pinch zoom (WCAG 1.4.4). Fix: content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1".

title: Positive tabindex 1-4 makes Tab hit the date fields before the search box
evidence: tabindex="3" on the search input (18), "1" and "2" on the date inputs (21, 24), "4" on Search (26): the tab order no longer follows the visual order, and these jump ahead of the header link. Fix: remove every tabindex attribute; if dates should come first, reorder the markup.

title: Shipped-date note #8a8a8a on white measures 3.45:1 at 14px
evidence: .note { color: #8a8a8a; font-size: 14px; } on the #ffffff ground (lines 8, 11, used on 24): 3.45:1 against the 4.5:1 bar for normal text. Fix: keep the neutral hue and darken it, e.g. color: #6b6b6b (5.33:1) or oklch(0.5 0.005 250).

title: White text on the amber booking button at 2.95:1 and card meta #64748b on #0f172a at 3.75:1
evidence: .btn white on oklch(0.68 0.14 75) at 16px = 2.95:1 (line 11; hover oklch(0.74 0.12 75) is lighter still, line 12); .card .meta #64748b on #0f172a = 3.75:1 (15). Both under 4.5:1. Fix: keep the amber hue and drop lightness, background: oklch(0.48 0.12 75) (6.65:1 with white; hover oklch(0.42 0.12 75)); .card .meta { color: #94a3b8; } (6.96:1).

title: Same day tag #6b7280 on #f1f5f9 measures 4.41:1, within 0.3 of the bar
evidence: .tag { background: #f1f5f9; color: #6b7280; } (line 13) = 4.41:1, under 4.5:1 by 0.09. Fix: color: #475569 on the same chip (6.92:1).
